# Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (Adyvka)
> Official Portfolio & Developer Knowledge Base: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id](https://adyvkapratama.my.id)

Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (widely recognized online as **Adyvka**) is a Software Engineer & Systems Architect based in Depok, West Java, Indonesia. He specializes in designing resilient, scalable distributed systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms, and multi-platform applications across web, mobile, and cloud environments.

- **Current Roles**:
  - Full Stack Engineer & Project Manager at PT Intisel Prodaktifakom (Feb 2026 — Present)
  - Full Stack Developer (Intern) at PT Ardyanda Digital Inovasi (Jul 2026 — Jan 2027)
- **Education**: Student majoring in Software Engineering (Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak) at SMK IDN Boarding School (Final Year · Year XII) & Harvard University CS50 Alumni
- **Specializations**: Clean Architecture, SOLID Principles, System Design, Polyglot Development, Distributed Systems, Multi-Tenant ERPs, RBAC & Cloud Security, Technical Curriculum Authoring
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Dart, PHP, C/C++, SQL, HTML5/CSS3
- **Frameworks & Tools**: NestJS, React 19, Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Docker, Tailwind CSS, AWS, Git/GitHub, Playwright

## Flagship Systems & Shipped Projects

### 1. [Databank ERP Ecosystem](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank)

- **Stack**: React 19, NestJS 11, PostgreSQL 14+, Prisma ORM, Docker, Playwright, React Virtuoso
- **Summary**: Enterprise telecommunication operations platform managing 50,000+ data rows lag-free, automated Huawei ISDP scraping bots, 3-stage sequential digital signature approval pipelines (PS/SS -> RPM -> SPM), 65 granular RBAC permissions, and GPS geofenced workforce attendance integrated into payroll.

## Published Books & Technical Learning Modules

Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama has authored and published 2 educational books and technical engineering modules:

### 1. "Membuat Game Tanpa Coding" (Creating Games Without Coding)
- **Author**: Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (Adyvka)
- **Publication Date**: January 2023 (First Edition)
- **Publisher**: SMK IDN Boarding School (Jonggol, West Java, Indonesia)
- **Format**: 125-Page Published E-Book / Educational Guide (PDF, 7.9 MB)
- **Core Topics**: MIT Scratch 3.0, visual block programming, 2D game loops, collision detection physics, state machines, and computational logic.
- **Table of Contents (6 Chapters)**:
  - BAB I: Membuat Game di Scratch (Introduction, Scratch installation, web interface, coordinate space)
  - BAB II: Catching Fruit (Fruit catching 2D game mechanics, gravity acceleration, script loops)
  - BAB III: Alien Invader (Space shooter mechanics, laser projectile cloning, collision detection)
  - BAB IV: Game Adab (Interactive educational ethics game with branching choices)
  - BAB V: Pacman (Maze navigation, wall color sensing, ghost patrol AI, collectible scoring)
  - BAB VI: Block Breaker (Paddle bounce physics, angle reflection, brick destruction grid)
- **Overview & Syllabus Page**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-game-tanpa-coding](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-game-tanpa-coding)
- **Direct PDF URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-game-tanpa-coding-adyvka.pdf](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-game-tanpa-coding-adyvka.pdf)
- **Interactive Directory**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects?filter=publications](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects?filter=publications)

### 2. "Membuat Website Dengan Mudah Menggunakan Framework" (Building Websites Easily with Frameworks)
- **Author**: Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (Adyvka)
- **Publication Date**: May 2024 (Student & Community Learning Edition)
- **Publisher**: SMK IDN Boarding School
- **Format**: 106-Page Technical Learning Module (PDF, 9.4 MB)
- **Core Topics**: Semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 styling, responsive mobile-first layouts, the CSS Box Model, and utility-first engineering with Tailwind CSS.
- **Table of Contents (4 Chapters)**:
  - BAB I: Pengenalan HTML Dasar (Web architecture, Head/Body syntax, VS Code + Live Server setup, semantic markup, tables & forms)
  - BAB II: Pengenalan CSS Dasar (Selectors, external stylesheets, Box Model: margin/padding/border, color systems, typography)
  - BAB III: Membuat Project HTML CSS (Building a complete modern landing page project from scratch with Flexbox)
  - BAB IV: Menggunakan Tailwind (Tailwind setup via CLI & CDN, utility classes, Flexbox/Grid, Tailblocks integration, responsive breakpoints)
- **Overview & Syllabus Page**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-website-dengan-framework](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-website-dengan-framework)
- **Direct PDF URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-website-dengan-framework-adyvka.pdf](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/publications/buku-membuat-website-dengan-framework-adyvka.pdf)
- **Interactive Directory**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects?filter=publications](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects?filter=publications)
